tiers.name: Rookie
tiers.blurb: Slow reactions, sloppy aim. Learn the rhythm.

tiers.name: Veteran
tiers.blurb: Plays the kit properly and heals on time.

tiers.name: Ace
tiers.blurb: Near frame-perfect. Beat this and you are one.

modes.name: Mace
modes.tagline: Wind charge up. Come down like a meteor.
modes.summary: The base MacePvP kit: mace, wind charges, elytra with no rockets. Learn to launch, line up the fall and land the smash.

drills.name: Launch & Smash
drills.goal: Wind-charge up and smash the stationary dummy. Score is your total smash damage over 10 attempts.

drills.name: Moving Target
drills.goal: The dummy strafes and jumps. Land as many smashes as you can in 60 seconds.

drills.name: Smash Chain
drills.goal: Chain smashes back to back: every smash within 4 s of the last one extends the chain. Best chain in 90 seconds.

modes.name: Crystal
modes.summary: Standard Crystal PvP kit: netherite, totems, obsidian, end crystals, anchors. Train placement speed, totem discipline and survival.

drills.name: Place & Pop
drills.goal: Place and detonate crystals next to the armored dummy. Score is crystals detonated in 30 seconds.

drills.name: Totem Breaker
drills.goal: The dummy re-totems instantly. Pop as many totems as you can in 45 seconds.

drills.name: Under Fire
drills.goal: The bot crystals you non-stop. Re-totem and stay alive. Score is seconds survived (max 90).

modes.name: Spear
modes.tagline: Attribute-swap lunges with almost no cooldown.
modes.summary: Mace kit without the elytra, plus a Lunge III spear. Drill the swap until the lunge cooldown stops mattering.

drills.name: Lunge Lines
drills.goal: Lunge through the glowing rings in order. Score is rings cleared in 45 seconds.

drills.name: Attribute Swap
drills.goal: Lunge, swap, lunge. Score is lunges performed in 30 seconds: only fast swapping gets you past silver.

drills.name: Lunge Into Smash
drills.goal: Use a lunge to close distance, wind-charge up and finish with a mace smash. Smashes landed in 75 seconds.

modes.name: Elytra + Mace
modes.tagline: Climb, turn, rocket down, wings off, smash.
modes.summary: Mace kit plus firework rockets. Master the full dive: equip, climb, wait, look back down, rocket at the target, swap the elytra off at the last moment and mace.

drills.name: Takeoff
drills.goal: From the pad: equip elytra, take off and reach 60 blocks above the arena. Score is your best time out of 5 (lower is better).

drills.name: Dive Bomb
drills.goal: Dive on the stationary dummy, take the elytra off before impact and smash. Total smash damage over 6 dives.

drills.name: Full Sequence
drills.goal: The dummy moves. Complete full climb-dive-smash cycles. Clean dives (wings off before the hit) in 120 seconds.
